subject: Mathematics
title: Statistics
summary: Measures of central tendency — mean, median and mode — describe the centre of data. Measures of dispersion — range, mean deviation, variance and standard deviation — describe the spread.
Know formulas for ungrouped, discrete and grouped (continuous) data, and the shortcut (step-deviation) method.
JEE questions often test how mean and variance change when every observation is shifted or scaled, and combined mean/variance of two groups.

formulas.name: Mean
formulas.formula: x̄ = Σxᵢ/n;  for frequencies x̄ = Σfᵢxᵢ/Σfᵢ;  step deviation x̄ = A + (Σfᵢuᵢ/Σfᵢ)h, uᵢ = (xᵢ − A)/h

formulas.name: Median
formulas.formula: ungrouped: middle value of sorted data;  grouped: l + ((N/2 − C)/f) × h

formulas.name: Mode
formulas.formula: grouped: l + ((f₁ − f₀)/(2f₁ − f₀ − f₂)) × h;  empirical: mode ≈ 3 median − 2 mean

formulas.name: Mean deviation
formulas.formula: MD about a = Σ|xᵢ − a|/n;  minimum when a = median

formulas.name: Variance and SD
formulas.formula: σ² = Σ(xᵢ − x̄)²/n = Σxᵢ²/n − x̄²;  σ = √σ²

formulas.name: Effect of change of origin and scale
formulas.formula: yᵢ = axᵢ + b ⇒ ȳ = a x̄ + b;  σᵧ² = a²σₓ²;  σᵧ = |a|σₓ
formulas.note: Adding a constant doesn't change variance.

formulas.name: Coefficient of variation
formulas.when: Comparing variability of two series — lower CV is more consistent.

formulas.name: Combined variance
formulas.formula: σ² = [n₁(σ₁² + d₁²) + n₂(σ₂² + d₂²)]/(n₁ + n₂),  dᵢ = x̄ᵢ − x̄

formulas.name: Variance of first n natural numbers

topics.title: Choosing a measure
topics.explain: Mean uses all values but is affected by outliers; median is robust to outliers; mode suits categorical data. For skewed distributions the median is often better.

topics.title: Range and quartile deviation
topics.explain: Range = maximum − minimum. Quartile deviation = (Q₃ − Q₁)/2. Both are simple measures of spread.

topics.title: Variance shortcuts
topics.explain: Use σ² = Σx²/n − x̄² to avoid computing each deviation. For grouped data use the step-deviation method σ² = h²[Σfu²/N − (Σfu/N)²].

topics.title: Correcting wrong observations
topics.explain: If a value was recorded wrongly, correct Σx and Σx² by removing the wrong value and adding the right one, then recompute mean and variance.

topics.title: Properties of SD
topics.explain: SD is never negative; it is zero only if all values are equal. SD ≥ mean deviation about the mean.

topics.title: Missing data problems
topics.explain: Given mean and variance with one or two unknown values, set up equations from Σx = n x̄ and Σx² = n(σ² + x̄²).

ratta: y = ax + b ⇒ σᵧ = |a|σₓ (b doesn't matter).
